business: Docketra (B2B Practice Operations Platform for Indian CAs & CSs)
target: Partners, sole practitioners, and senior staff at Indian Chartered Accountancy, Company Secretary, and corporate tax compliance practices
where: Major Indian business centers (Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad)

behaviours.name: Excel & WhatsApp diehard
behaviours.how: Has run the practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for 10 years; deeply skeptical of new software unless dead simple.

behaviours.name: Paranoid about client confidentiality
behaviours.how: Terrified of data leaks; refused third-party cloud tools because they store ITR/PAN files in proprietary databases.

behaviours.name: Frugal tool buyer
behaviours.how: Wants flat, transparent pricing; hates per-user nickeling and hidden setup fees.

behaviours.name: Deadline & peer-review panic
behaviours.how: Stresses out during July ITR and October ROC filing rush; desperate for maker-checker accountability over article clerks.

behaviours.name: Tech-forward modern practitioner
behaviours.how: Active on LinkedIn, uses modern Mac/PC apps, eager to automate client intake and follow-ups.

behaviours.name: Burned by legacy CA software
behaviours.how: Tried Jamku or desktop ERP; found it cluttered, slow, or abandoned by staff after 2 months.

objections: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp.
Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free?
Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?
Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time.
If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
habits: you check 30 unread WhatsApp client groups every morning before tea
you spend 2 hours every Saturday reconciling which GST filings are still pending
you get anxious when an article clerk leaves the firm with client data on their personal laptop
you attend your local ICAI/ICSI study circle meet once a month
you do final review of ROC annual filing annexures at 10 PM during busy season
